data.name: Ameerat
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic word ‘Amir’ meaning commander or ruler. This name signifies a woman of power and authority in Islamic culture. In the Quran, Allah (swt) says: ‘And when We assign them a leader, they will believe in him.’ (Quran 17:63).
data.spiritual_meaning: A symbol of strength and leadership in the faith.
data.numerology_meaning: Expressive, creative, and enthusiastic, Ameerat is an individual who loves to be the center of attention and has a natural ability to inspire others. She is also a natural leader with a strong will and a deep sense of purpose.

in_arabic.name: أميرات
in_arabic.long_meaning: أميرات هي كلمة عربية تعني المرأة الأمير أو الزوجة الأمير، وهي مشتقة من كلمة أمير التي تعني القائد أو الحاكم، وتستخدم هذه الكلمة في القرآن الكريم في سياقات مختلفة لوصف الزوجات الأميرات والنساء العاليات المنزلة

in_urdu.name: امیرات
in_urdu.long_meaning: امیرات ایک عربی لفظ ہے جس کا مطلب ہے خاتون یا ملکہ، یہ لفظ امیر سے ماخوذ ہے جس کا مطلب ہے قائد یا حاکم، اور یہ لفظ قرآن پاک میں مختلف سیاق و سباق میں استعمال ہوا ہے تاکہ خواتین امراء اور عالی منزلت خواتین کی وضاحت کی جائے

in_hindi.name: अमीरात
in_hindi.long_meaning: अमीरात एक अरबी शब्द है जिसका अर्थ है महिला अमीर या रानी, यह शब्द अमीर से उत्पन्न हुआ है जिसका अर्थ है नेता या शासक, और यह शब्द कुरान में विभिन्न संदर्भों में उपयोग किया गया है ताकि महिला अमीरों और उच्च पदस्थ महिलाओं का वर्णन किया जा सके

in_pashto.name: امیرات
in_pashto.long_meaning: امیرات د عربي ژبه څخه یو لفظ دی چې معنا یې د امير ښځه یا ملکه ده، دا لفظ د امير څخه اخیستل شوی دی چې معنا یې قوماندان یا حاکم دی، او دا لفظ په قرآن کریم کې په ګډوډ سیاق کې کارول شوی دی څو د امير ښځو او لوړ پوړو ښځو څرګندونه وشي

in_english.name: Ameerat

data.cultural_impact: The name "Ameerat" carries a powerful meaning in Islamic culture. It connotes a woman of substance, strength, and leadership. She is a role model for girls and women, exemplifying the potential for women to attain positions of power and influence. This name signifies an individual who is effective, reliable, and takes on responsibilities, making them a valuable asset to their community.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name "Ameerat" embodies the Islamic value of leadership and authority rooted in faith. It reminds us that Allah (swt) assigns leaders for us to believe and trust in. As Muslims, we strive to embody the qualities of a good leader – wisdom, justice, compassion, and humility – in our daily lives. By carrying this name, one may be reminded to strive towards becoming a leader in their community or household, modeled on the example of the Prophet Muhammad (SAW) who led his community with compassion, wisdom, and obedience to Allah (swt). This name invites us to ponder the role of leadership in our faith and become leaders who inspire, uplift, and strengthen those around us.
